body_lead: Home |Hyderabad |Telangana Govt Degree Colleges Roll Out Ai Ml Courses Telangana: Govt degree colleges roll out AI, ML courses Hyderabad: Students wishing to pursue their under graduation from the government degree colleges will have new courses to choose from. Starting this academic year, 11 autonomous government degree colleges are rolling out BSc in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, a three-year degree programme.
